guide.title: TerminalNexus Detailed Guide & Operating Manual
guide.subtitle:
Your private, sandboxed terminal environment right in the web browser
From sign-up to local CLI setup, remote port forwarding, and security sandbox policies
guide.step1_desc: Click 'Sign Up' in the upper-right corner to create a personal, isolated account via secure email verification or standard OAuth2 providers (Google, Naver). Upon successful registration, a unique authorization token is provisioned to maintain secure session management.
guide.step2_desc: Once authenticated, click 'Create Terminal' on your main dashboard. Our backend immediately allocates a dedicated container sandbox (1vCPU, 512MB RAM). Standard shells like Bash and Zsh are fully supported alongside essential developer tools (Git, Curl, Vim, Nano).
guide.step3_title: TN CLI Tool Installation & Port Forwarding
guide.step3_desc: Install the helper CLI globally by running 'npm install -g @terminalnexus/cli' on your local computer. Synchronize credentials with 'tn login', and spawn secure SSH tunnels using 'tn ssh' or manage remote port redirection with 'tn forward -p 3000' commands.
guide.step4_desc: Use the Free Board to share shell script templates and exchange tips. Our built-in markdown editor renders rich content and syntax highlighting smoothly. You can update profile credentials, nickname aliases, and plan tiers in My Page at any time.
guide.faq1_q: Q. What resources and constraints apply to the free sandbox plan?
guide.faq1_a: A. Free members receive permanent access to the remote terminal sandbox, live chat lobbies, and community boards. A single session has a continuous execution timeout of 2 hours, after which background processes are automatically paused to prevent server abuse.
guide.faq2_q: Q. Is my sandbox state permanently saved after logouts or session drops?
guide.faq2_a: A. Yes, all workspace files and configurations are stored in an encrypted persistent storage volume. Reconnecting to the service restores your previous workspace state exactly where you left off, ensuring maximum development continuity.
guide.faq3_q: Q. What measures secure OAuth2 integration and passwords?
guide.faq3_a: A. We adhere strictly to standard OAuth2 specifications. Passwords are securely hashed using the BCrypt algorithm, and credentials are protected with Json Web Tokens (JWT) using distinct Access/Refresh tokens to defend against credential harvesting.
guide.contact_desc: For immediate technical troubleshooting, bug reporting, partnership proposals, or AdSense issues, please send an inquiry email to our support team. A senior engineer will review the log diagnostics and reply within 24 hours.
